# QA-FINAL: the final QA pass

<!-- Generated by scripts/qa_matrix.py --write from docs/test-plan/data/qa-final.json; edit the data, not this file. -->

Every surface the harness ships, in every dimension the final pass judges (function, performance, UX and accessibility, latency, accuracy, recorded parity), with what proves it today, the lanes that run that proof, and the gap that remains. The reported cases each name the regression tests that hold them, at the level the bug lived. `scripts/qa_matrix.py --check` keeps this true to the tree: every proof path exists, every regression test still holds the case it names, every lane is one the pass runs or a named place it cannot.

## How to run the final pass

```bash
scripts/qa_final.sh --out <dir>                                      # every local lane, in order, then the summary
scripts/qa_final.sh --out <dir> --sample                             # each lane on a small selection: proves the wiring
scripts/qa_final.sh --list                                           # the lanes, in the order they run
```

Before the pass, on the tree under test: `scripts/qa_full.sh --out <dir> --lanes ux --update-ux-baselines`, so the captures compare with today's screens (baselines live outside git, and changes that alter a screen on purpose leave them behind). The human-stack lane reads the human-test stack (scripts/human-test-stack.sh); it is skipped where none is up.

The pass writes `final.md` and `final.json` beside qa_full's `index.html` and `report.json`: each row below marked *proven here* (its gap is none and every local lane it names passed), *proven here, gap …* (its local lanes passed; the rest is the gap), *failed*, *not run*, or what it waits on (*needs live model*, *needs reference host*, *needs CI*). The lanes run fastest first, so a broken tree fails within minutes: the reported cases' regressions, then unit, contracts, replay, integration, frontend and stores, then the lanes that share one e2e stack, then the lanes that bring up their own (MCP hub, options matrix, engines, PostgreSQL and air gap, fault, perf), and the human-test stack's smoke last. No lane makes a paid or live model call.

## Reported cases and their regression tests

| Report | Fix row | Where the bug lived | Regression tests (lane) |
|---|---|---|---|
| The open job's Brief was the whole prompt the chat composed for the engine (verbose and ugly) | BGUI-10 JOB-BRIEF-READABLE | Python (where the task text is made), Node (the brief API), frontend (the Brief) | `backend/python/tests/unit/harness/assembly/test_bgui10_task_parts.py` (regressions)<br>`backend/nodejs/apps/tests/modules/agent-harness/bgui10-job-task.test.ts` (regressions)<br>`frontend/app/(main)/chat/components/activity-panel/__tests__/bgui10-job-brief.test.tsx` (regressions)<br>`frontend/tests/e2e/harness/classic-jobs-engine.spec.ts` (docker) |
| A job report printed the engine's reply with a raw ::artifact[...] line, bare citation numbers and process talk | BGUI-11 JOB-OUTPUTS | frontend (the report rendered the engine's text raw), Node (one file classification), Python (the hand-back note) | `frontend/app/(main)/chat/components/message-area/job-card/__tests__/bgui11-job-outputs.test.tsx` (regressions)<br>`backend/nodejs/apps/tests/modules/agent-harness/projection/bgui11-job-files.test.ts` (regressions)<br>`backend/python/tests/unit/harness/assembly/test_bgui11_handback.py` (regressions)<br>`frontend/tests/e2e/harness/classic-jobs-engine.spec.ts` (docker) |
| Citation chips with no source behind them, in the job panel's reply and then in the chat's own answer | BGUI-12 JOB-REPLY-CITATIONS, BGUI-13 ANSWER-CITATIONS, BGUI11-FU-2, BGUI12-FU-1 | Node (the timeline dropped the answer's citations), frontend (one cited-answer rule for chat and job reply) | `backend/nodejs/apps/tests/modules/agent-harness/bgui12-answer-citations.test.ts` (regressions)<br>`frontend/app/(main)/chat/components/message-area/job-card/__tests__/bgui12-job-reply-citations.test.tsx` (regressions)<br>`frontend/app/(main)/chat/utils/__tests__/bgui13-cited-answer.test.ts` (regressions)<br>`frontend/app/(main)/chat/components/message-area/__tests__/bgui13-main-answer-citations.test.tsx` (regressions)<br>`frontend/tests/e2e/harness/classic-jobs-engine.spec.ts` (docker) |
| Skipping the question card made the chat ask the same thing again and again | ANSWER-CONTRACT-SKIP | Python (the grounding gate read Skip as a picked record; a new message re-asked the subject) | `backend/python/tests/unit/harness/assembly/test_answer_contract_skip.py` (regressions)<br>`frontend/tests/e2e/harness/answer-contract-engine.spec.ts` (docker) |

| A connected MCP server went unused with a bare mcp_unavailable (admin pre-approval by default); a person's Allow still asked on an engine job; an unresolved MCP call ran with no rule read | MCPNOTE-1, MCPNOTE-FU-2, GATE-FAILOPEN-1 | Python (admission seam, the engine's default-ask policy, the approval gate), frontend (the per-server notice) | `backend/python/tests/unit/harness/mcp_hub/test_mcpnote_hub_approval.py` (regressions)<br>`backend/python/tests/unit/agents/test_mcpnote_unlisted_reason.py` (regressions)<br>`backend/python/tests/unit/harness/assembly/test_allow1_engine_tool_allow.py` (regressions)<br>`backend/python/tests/unit/agents/agent_loop/test_gate_failopen.py` (regressions)<br>`frontend/app/(main)/chat/components/message-area/__tests__/mcpnote-unavailable-notice.test.tsx` (regressions)<br>`integration-tests/harness/e2e/test_mcpnote_unlisted_servers.py` (mcphub)<br>`frontend/tests/e2e/harness/mcpnote-notice.spec.ts` (e2e) |

## Lanes

| Lane | Where | What it runs | About (min) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `regressions` | local | The reported cases: every regression test below that needs no stack (Python, Node, vitest) | 6 |
| `unit` | local | Python unit and cohesion, Node unit with its coverage floor, Node typecheck | 45 |
| `contracts` | local | Python contracts (C-5 codegen, goldens, schemas) | 8 |
| `replay` | local | Harness replay (recorded runs against today's kernel) | 5 |
| `integration` | local | Python integration with no infrastructure | 10 |
| `frontend` | local | vitest (app, lib, e2e support), typecheck, lint, locale parity and keys | 20 |
| `stores` | local | Node itests on MongoDB, Redis and PostgreSQL (with PgBouncer) | 25 |
| `ux` | local | UX screenshots of the classic interface against baselines (ux-shots) | 25 |
| `latency` | local | Browser latency budgets on the scripted model (qa-latency) | 15 |
| `e2e` | local | Playwright harness, authenticated and qa-indexed projects on a run.sh stack | 90 |
| `mcphub` | local | MCP-E2E modules, each on its own hub-on stack (integration-tests/harness/e2e --mcp-hub) | 120 |
| `matrix` | local | Options-matrix rows of ST-1 (pairwise and three-way) | 90 |
| `docker` | local | Sandbox and engines in Docker, then real engine runs in the browser (run.sh durable) | 120 |
| `ops` | local | The whole flow on the PostgreSQL document store and on networks with no route out (run.sh pg, run.sh airgap) | 120 |
| `fault` | local | Crash points on real processes, Redis Streams broker (integration-tests/harness/fault) | 60 |
| `perf` | local | Perf rig profiles (PF-05, latency SLOs) and a short soak | 60 |
| `human-stack` | local | Smoke on the human-test stack (scripted model pinned) | 15 |
| `ci` | ci | Only a GitHub workflow runs it (Helm kind smoke, backend matrix, published-hub footprint) | — |
| `reference-host` | reference-host | Needs the reference host: gVisor or Kata isolation, the 24 h soak, Kubernetes | — |
| `live` | live | Needs a live model call (within the run's spend cap) | — |
